about_the_game:
Welcome to SlimeBuddyTime, your cozy haven of cuteness and relaxation!

Adopt an adorable slime and share everyday moments as you grow together. In this charming idle game with Tamagotchi vibes, you'll care for, play with, and pamper your fluffy friend while customizing their world to your liking.

✨ Key Features

  • Care for and pamper your slime: feed it, bathe it, pet it, and keep it happy.

  • Play relaxing and fun minigames like catching frisbees, going on walks, or chasing flying snacks.

  • Level up and unlock a collection of cute items to personalize your slime and decorate its home.

  • Collect medals and show off your achievements as your pet grows.

  • Live with up to 3 slimes at once—perfect companions while you study, work, or simply unwind.

With its soft visuals and comforting vibe, SlimeBuddyTime is perfect for anyone seeking a calm, tender, and heartwarming experience. You’ll never be alone again—your slimes will be by your side every step of the way.
